craft_notes: Sthāyin: wonder at undividedness. Device: dash→comma — paradox stated softly, bow continuous (enjambment kept: bow must touch its object). Bright: the all-shared shape, held whole, never dissected. Rejected: resolving the paradox — killed: stating the suggested drops the dhvani-rank, the verse performs non-difference; 'we kneel' — killed: L3's loved bend stands. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: What splits, unsplit; what severs, whole, we bend
to that all-shared shape of the Highest Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhinneṣv api na bhinnaṃ yac chinneṣv achinnam eva ca namāmaḥ sarvasāmānyaṃ rūpaṃ tat pārameśvaram

reads_against.argmap: Among the split, not split; among the cut, uncut indeed.; All-common form, that supreme Lord's: we bow. → Bow to the all-common supreme form, undivided in division.
c1_essence: Vast Śambhu of withdrawn touch and full nectar; all-common supreme form undivided in division.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-vismaya (devotion charged with wonder); sthayibhava utsāha-in-bhakti

l2.plain_english: Among the split, not split; among the cut, wholly uncut — we bow to that all-common form of the supreme Lord.
